s: Din tashmish hammitta beyom hakkippurim ubo b' seipim: kebar bearnu sheyyom hakkippurim asur betashmish hammitta, ulepi shellibbo shel adam gas im ishto ubeqal yukal labo immah lide hergel dabar, lepikak tzarik linhog immah beyom hakkippurim kol harchaqot shennoheg immah bime tumat niddatah, dehaynu shello yigga bah, veen tzarik lomar shello yishan immah bemitta achat apillu hu bebigdo vehi bebigdah, veken lo yarbeh immah bidbarim, veken bekol happeratim shennitbaaru beyoreh dea siman qtz"h. Ubekol debarim ellu tzarik lehizzaher ben belel yom hakkippurim ben bayyom:

Haroeh qeri belel yom hakkippurim — yidag kol hashshana, shemma lo qibbelu taanito vehisbiuhu bemah shebbeyadam lehasbio, keebed shebba limzog kos lerabbo veshopek lo rabbo haqqiton (perush qiton shel mayim shemmimmenna mozeg hakkos shel yayin) al panayv, kelomar i epshi beshimmusheka, veim olta lo shana — mubtach lo shehu ben olam habba, shebbevadday yesh lo zekuyyot harbeh shehegennu alayv, vehu yaarik yamim, shekkak hassiman "yireh zera — yaarik yamim":
